newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Los Pelambres sees early output rising.
newsitem.headline: Chile Los Pelambres sees early output rising.

text.p: Chilean copper mine Los Pelambres said it expects to produce between 250,000 and 260,000 tonnes of copper a year when the pit's expansion comes on stream in 1999, with output then slipping to 230,000 tonnes.
"Output will rise to between 250,000 and 260,000 tonnes of copper in the first years," said Roberto Salinas, deputy general manager at Minera Anaconda which is developing the pit.
Salinas said the mine will keep up this level of production for at least the first five years of its life.
